text: When I came back. <break time="0.8s" /> From returning the buggy. <break time="0.8s" /> Bill was putting bandages. <break time="0.8s" /> On his scratches and bruises. <break time="0.8s" /> A fire was burning. <break time="0.8s" /> At the mouth of the cave. <break time="0.8s" /> And the boy was watching. <break time="0.8s" /> A pot of boiling coffee. <break time="0.8s" /> He pointed a stick at me. <break time="0.8s" /> And shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> Do you dare to enter. <break time="0.8s" /> The camp of Red Chief. <break time="0.8s" /> In the boys game. <break time="0.8s" /> Bill was Old Hank the Trapper. <break time="0.8s" /> And I was Snake eye the Spy. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy loved camping in the cave. <break time="0.8s" /> So much that he forgot. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was a captive himself. <break time="0.8s" /> I like this fine. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have never had so much fun. <break time="0.8s" /> In all my life he said. <break time="0.8s" /> At supper. <break time="0.8s" /> He told us that he hated school. <break time="0.8s" /> And that he had once owned. <break time="0.8s" /> A pet possum. <break time="0.8s" /> We went to bed late. <break time="0.8s" /> But the boy kept us awake. <break time="0.8s" /> For hours. <break time="0.8s" /> Jumping up at every small sound. <break time="0.8s" /> At daybreak. <break time="0.8s" /> I was awakened. <break time="0.8s" /> By a series of terrible screams. <break time="0.8s" /> From Bill. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy was sitting on Bills chest. <break time="0.8s" /> Waving the knife. <break time="0.8s" /> We used for bacon. <break time="0.8s" /> In a wild game. <break time="0.8s" /> I took the knife away. <break time="0.8s" /> But from that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> Bills spirit was broken.
